field.rationale: Illustrative ~850 m crop window chosen as 99.7% cropland in usda-cdl 2021; the crop grown in the box each season is not verified; not a property boundary.

crops.calendar_source: Field Crops Usual Planting and Harvesting Dates (Agricultural Handbook 628), USDA NASS, October 2010 — https://esmis.nal.usda.gov/sites/default/release-files/vm40xr56k/dv13zw65p/z603r1055/planting-10-29-2010.txt

Field Crops Usual Planting and Harvesting Dates (Agricultural Handbook 628), USDA NASS, October 2010 — https://esmis.nal.usda.gov/sites/default/release-files/vm40xr56k/dv13zw65p/z603r1055/planting-10-29-2010.txt

soil.source: AD4 available-water class (Gaiapus hypothesis, not a soil survey)

weather.source: NASA POWER daily point, community AG (rain: IMERG_PRECTOT); ET0 FAO-56 Penman-Monteith

water_balance.method: FAO-56 Kc single crop coefficient, fixed root zone (hypothesis)

ndvi.source: NASA HLS v2 (L30/S30), Microsoft Planetary Computer; median NDVI of clear pixels (Fmask), >=65% clear coverage
ndvi.method: NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red); 0 overlapping-tile duplicate(s) removed; 0 scene(s) dropped for asset read errors

forecast.source: Open-Meteo forecast API, model ecmwf_ifs025 (ECMWF IFS 0.25), UTC daily sums
